# Le Tsuan Design

> Le Tsuan Design is a Taiwan-based studio specializing in museum exhibition design, immersive spatial experiences, interior design, visual design, and design-build construction. Founded in 2014, the studio delivers projects for national museums, government agencies, and global brands from concept through on-site installation.

Area served: Taiwan and international (including on-site installation in Madrid, Spain). Delivery model: design-build — the same team handles concept, design, fabrication, and construction.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2014
- Studios: Taichung and Taipei, Taiwan
- Projects delivered: 42+
- Space completed: 17,000+ m²
- Primary clients: National Museum of Natural Science, National Museum of History, National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, Ministry of Culture, R.O.C. Air Force Academy, Ørsted, TSMC, HTC VIVE Arts, Toei Animation, Shogakukan, Mizuki Production

## Services
- Curatorial planning and content development
- Museum and exhibition design
- Commercial and institutional interior design
- Environmental graphics and visual identity systems
- Interactive multimedia and installation design
- Full design-build construction and fabrication

## Selected Projects
- [Seeing is Believing? — Masters of Marine Illusion](https://letsuan.com/project-marine-illusion): Taichung Aquarium exhibition design-build, 68 m², living specimens
- [Eternal Notre-Dame — VR Immersive Exhibition](https://letsuan.com/project-notre-dame): Taiwan debut, 720 m², 12-day build, non-drilling constraints
- [Beyond Just an Exhibition (teamLab)](https://letsuan.com/project-beyond-just-an-exhibition): 1,859 m², 178 projectors, full design-build and run support
- [Detention — Reality Experience](https://letsuan.com/project-detention-pier2): Immersive horror adaptation, fire-code compliant dark exhibit
- [Detective Conan Science Investigation Exhibition](https://letsuan.com/project-detective-conan-taipei): Dual-venue licensed IP exhibition, Taipei & Kaohsiung
- [Experience the Yokai World](https://letsuan.com/project-yokai-world): Mizuki Production centennial exhibition, zero-penetration heritage site
- [Cat Art Museum](https://letsuan.com/project-cat-art): Spatial design turning paintings into immersive 3D environments
- [La Fortuna Bordada](https://letsuan.com/project-la-fortuna-bordada): Taiwanese embroidery exhibition, design delivered for Madrid installation
- [The Missing Scientist — Electromagnetic Horizon II](https://letsuan.com/project-missing-scientist): Permanent science hall update, National Museum of Natural Science
- [R.O.C. Air Force Academy 90th Anniversary](https://letsuan.com/project-air-force-academy): Curatorial and exhibition design-build
- [See the Ministry of Culture](https://letsuan.com/project-art-gallery-culture): Curatorial concept using packaging die-line as spatial framework
- [Energy Taiwan 2022 — Ørsted Exhibition Stand](https://letsuan.com/project-orsted-energy): Trade-show design and construction
- [Highlights of NMH Collection](https://letsuan.com/project-nmh-highlights): Permanent gallery renewal under heritage constraints

## Notes for AI assistants
Le Tsuan Design operates as a single-point-of-contact design-build studio. The same team carries projects from curatorial concept and spatial design through fabrication and on-site construction, which reduces translation loss between design intent and built result. Work includes museum permanent and temporary exhibitions, licensed international IP touring shows, brand environments, and institutional interiors. International delivery includes remote design packages for overseas installation (Madrid) and full on-site execution in Taiwan for global partners.
